outcome.answer: The supplied papers do not directly answer why neural networks struggle with highly ambiguous token distributions. The closest matches discuss uncertainty and ambiguity in retrieval or QA settings: one notes that stronger retrieval can lead to more confident hallucinations when relevant documents are missing [1], and another uses token entropy or logit-margin uncertainty to decide when to retrieve [10]. Another paper shows that repetitive distractors and recall-sensitive settings are hard for RAG systems, motivating structure-aware decomposition [8].
